claims.claim: MAS issued draft AI Risk Management Guidelines
claims.reason: S1/S2 say MAS has issued Guidelines for AI Risk Management for public consultation, which means they are a draft. Neither source says when they were issued.
S6 lists consultation number P015-2026, starting 1 September 2026, on amendments to the PS Act for stablecoins. S8 confirms MAS published it.
S6 gives the closing date as 16 October 2026, and the other sources say Oct 16.

S9 says the Financial Services and Markets (Amendment) Bill 2026, which empowers MAS to impose TLAC requirements, was moved for First Reading. A minister moved it on behalf of the Minister-in-charge of MAS. MAS published the explanatory brief.
S10 says MAS Notice 643A (Amendment) 2026 was issued on 4 September 2026 and takes effect on 4 September 2027.

claims.claim: MAS issued a national AML strategy
claims.reason: S13, published 23 September 2026 (before the run date), says Singapore published a national AML strategy produced jointly by MHA, MOF and MAS. MAS is one of the co-authors, but it did not issue the strategy alone. The article also carries an inconsistent 'Oct 30' dateline.
